## Launch Campaign

Transitions an existing `Campaign` (already built on this realm, not rebuilt here) from `planned` to `running`. `campaign.gts`'s own `CampaignStatusField` is a plain enum with no transition graph (unlike Order/Payment/Pipeline Stage/Payment Status), so this command carries its own guard rather than reaching for `canTransition` — extracting a full statusField for Campaign was judged out of scope (Campaign itself isn't one of the 18 concepts this app fills; only this command is).

### Non-goals
Does not build or send campaign creative/content — purely the lifecycle transition.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at the real, already-existing `Campaign/logistics-expo-2026` instance (`status: 'planned'`) — exactly the precondition this command requires.
attributes.cardDescription: Transitions an existing Campaign from 'planned' to 'running'.
